statement: Local benchmark and prospective contributor trial are in progress; no new dependency hypothesis has yet passed the completed pilot evaluation.
status: Initialization in progress; donor intake closed; awaiting a maintainer
scope: Pinned DepMap 24Q2 Public v1, fixed 12-target panel. No cancer-versus-normal selectivity, mechanistic causality, drug efficacy or novelty is established.

assumptions.statement: Independent computational and scientific review has not occurred.
Release-provided screen processing is not refitted separately for each prediction fold.
Candidate-specific novelty remains unestablished; literature-based pairs are known controls.

reproduce_full: .venv/bin/python src/benchmark.py develop --out research/replay && .venv/bin/python src/benchmark.py finalize --out research/replay
